description: Exponential-function (អនុគមន៍អិចស្ប៉ូណង់ស្យែល) drills: solving simple exponential equations, simplifying/proving exponential fraction identities, squared-exponential identities, sketching basic e^x-based curves from a described shift/sign, limits at infinity, asymptote proofs, and full multi-part exponential curve studies (domain, limits, asymptote, derivative, variation, tangent, sketch).

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 6: អនុគមន៍អិចស្ប៉ូណង់ស្យែល (Exponential Functions) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-28

exercises.technique: Solve e^{f(x)}=k by taking ln, or factor out e^{kx}\ne0 to reduce to solving f(x)=0
Algebraic identity proof: split a rational-exponential expression into polynomial + proper-fraction remainder (used later for asymptote-finding)
Expand/prove algebraic identities involving e^x using (a\pm b)^2 and difference-of-squares patterns
Study/sketch the basic shape (sign, monotonicity, limiting behavior) of a described e^x-based function
Limits at infinity of e^x-based expressions, used to find horizontal/oblique asymptotes

exercises.prompt_latex: f(x)=(e^x-1)/(e^x+1),\ \text{find}\ \lim_{x\to\pm\infty}f(x);\ f(x)=x+1-2e^x,\ \text{limit as}\ x\to-\infty;\ f(x)=1-x+3e^{-x},\ \text{prove}\ (d):y=-x+1\ \text{is asymptote};\ f(x)=x-2-4e^x/(e^x+2),\ \text{prove}\ (L):y=x-2\ \text{is asymptote};\ f(x)=x+(x-1)/e^x,\ \text{prove}\ (D):y=x\ \text{is asymptote};\ f(x)=-x-2+3/(e^x+2),\ \text{prove}\ (\Delta):y=-x-2\ \text{is asymptote};\ \text{find derivative sign of}\ f(x)=(x-1)e^x,\ 2xe^{-x},\ (2-x)e^{2x},\ (-x-1)/e^{2x},\ (x^2-1)e^x,\ (2x-x^2)/e^{2x},\ (x^2+x-2)e^{-x}
exercises.technique: Prove a given oblique/horizontal asymptote by showing lim [f(x)-line]=0; determine derivative sign for variation table
Compute derivative, or verify a claimed derivative identity, for products/quotients of x and e^x

exercises.prompt_latex: \text{Tangent line at}\ x_0=0\ \text{for}\ f(x)=(2x-3)e^{-x},(x^2-2)e^{2x},e^x/(x^2-1),x-e^x/(e^x+1);\ \text{find sign of}\ f'(x)\ \text{for}\ f(x)=e^x-x+1,2x-e^x+1,e^{-x}+x-1,e^{2x}-2x+1,2x+e^{-x}-1,2e^{-2x}+4x,(x-1)e^x,(2x-1)e^{-x}+1,x^2e^x,x^2e^{-2x}+1,(x+1)/e^x,(2x+3)/e^{-x};\ \text{concavity study of}\ f(x)=e^x-1+2x,3-x+2e^{-x},(x^2+2)e^x,2e^x/(e^x+1),x-1+2/(e^x+1),x+1-4e^x/(e^x+1);\ \text{find asymptote pairs for}\ (x-2)e^{-x},(x^2-1)e^{2x},(x+1)/e^{2x},(e^x-2)/(e^x+1);\ \text{find asymptote}\ (d)\ \text{for}\ x+1-xe^x=x+1\text{-line},\ 2-x+(x+1)/e^x,\ 1+(x-2)e^{-x};\ \text{find inflection}\ I(0,1)\ \text{on}\ f(x)=(3e^x-1)/(e^x+1);\ I(0,2)\ \text{on}\ f(x)=4e^x/(e^x+1);\ \text{full studies}: f(x)=x+e^x\ (e^{-1}=0.36);\ f(x)=1+e^{1-x};\ f(x)=x+3-e^x;\ f(x)=e^x-x-1;\ f(x)=3+x-2e^{-x};\ f(x)=-x^2e^x;\ f(x)=1+xe^x;\ f(x)=(2x+1)e^{-2x}
exercises.technique: Full exponential-function study (BAC-II style, ~4-6 parts each): domain, limits, asymptote proof, derivative + sign, variation table, tangent line at a point, inflection point, sketch of curve C, sometimes with a parametrized-family or numeric-approximation twist (given e^{-1}, e^2 values)
Full exponential-function study with an auxiliary function g(x) introduced first (sign of g used to determine sign of f', e.g. f'(x)=e^{-x}g(x))
